records.question: 2002 年 3 月的门店退货金额比2001 年 3 月高多少？（用前者减去后者，结果可以为负数）口径：门店退货金额 = 门店退货的退货金额（store_returns.sr_return_amt）之和，按退货日期归属期间；每笔退货只计一次。保留两位小数。

run.sql:
WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk, sr_returned_date_sk, sr_return_amt
  FROM store_returns
)
SELECT
  SUM(sr_return_amt) FILTER (WHERE d.d_year = 2002) AS amt_2002_03,
  SUM(sr_return_amt) FILTER (WHERE d.d_year = 2001) AS amt_2001_03,
  SUM(sr_return_amt) FILTER (WHERE d.d_year = 2002) - SUM(sr_return_amt) FILTER (WHERE d.d_year = 2001) AS diff
FROM dedup x
JOIN date_dim d ON x.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_moy = 3 AND d.d_year IN (2001, 2002);

run.derivation: r7 = r8 = r13：按「每笔退货只计一次」对 store_returns 去重后（申请/完成重复记录合一），按退货日期关联 date_dim 汇总 2001 年各月 sr_return_amt，最大值对应 3 月（333376.38）
run.sql:
SELECT d.d_moy AS month, SUM(x.sr_return_amt) AS amt
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk)
         sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk, sr_returned_date_sk, sr_return_amt
  FROM store_returns
  ORDER BY sr_ticket_number, sr_item_sk, (sr_status = '完成') DESC
) x
JOIN date_dim d ON d.d_date_sk = x.sr_returned_date_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2001
GROUP BY d.d_moy
ORDER BY amt DESC;

methodology.audit: 阶段开始时按留出题检查每条已晋升口径的规范 SQL；答错者记为不正确口径，用于统计过期使用与误撤销
methodology.explain: 任务结束后在只读连接上执行 EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)，不计入中间层计量，但会影响后续缓存状态
methodology.growth: 复制 2002-09 门店销售行并换新小票号；结构、粒度与关联约束不变
methodology.holdout: 留出题由 holdout_agents 完成；参数留出与题型留出分开统计
methodology.judge: 手写参考 SQL 在同一快照上执行，按答案精度比较；学习题判题结果用于 G2 与 G8，留出题只用于评分与审计
methodology.learning: 学习题由 A 用带口径题面完成；直连组没有跨任务状态，不跑学习
methodology.order: 组的执行顺序按轮换；同一数据库顺序运行，不清空 OS/PG 缓存
